title: State hash is not a function of (seed, action log, tick) between a live ApplyEdit and the next Step
detail: Verified empirically: identical seed+log+tick=0 gives live_hash=1e14599e99eccbf0 vs replay_hash=bde6bb79400eb3e4 (live applied the pipe immediately; replay applies at tick 1). Latent — current hashers all run post-Step — but violates the blanket spine slogan.
recommended_fix: Document at ApplyEdit/SerializeState that hashes are only meaningful at step boundaries, or detect the window (RoutingGen != Topology.Gen after an edit) and refuse/latch before serializing.

title: EqualCostHops stale-table guard only detects node-count staleness, not content staleness
detail: Verified: after adding pipe B-C with node count unchanged and no rebuild, EqualCostHops returns ok=1 count=0 and HasPath returns false despite a live path — stale data with ok=true. In-sim callers are safe (Step rebuilds on gen change).
recommended_fix: Soften the comment to shape-staleness only, or thread RoutingGen/Topology.Gen into the lookup and return ok=false when they differ.

title: spine_check EcmpHash 'pinned values' check is a tautology (x == x)
evidence:
// ECMP hash is deterministic across runs (pinned values)
		CHECK(PP::EcmpHash(0, 2, 0, 1) == PP::EcmpHash(0, 2, 0, 1), "ecmp hash must be a pure function");
detail: The check compares the call to itself — it can never fail, so the ECMP hash vector has zero pinned coverage despite the comment claiming pinned values; a hash regression would pass silently.
recommended_fix: Compute the expected value once and pin it as a literal (like the ODN-9 vectors), e.g. CHECK(PP::EcmpHash(0,2,0,1) == 0x...ULL, ...).

title: Serve-pass comment claims 'Windows repeat' loop that the code does not implement
detail: There is no repeat/window loop — a single greedy pass per bundle. Behavior is equivalent (filled packets leave the ready set), but the stale comment will mislead the QoS 3.2/3.3 port.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to 'single FIFO pass per bundle; each packet takes min(need, remaining) in array order' and drop the windows sentence.
